context.transcript:
m Thanks for listening to Weekend Science! I'm your
host, Paul Farooq. ®My guest today is Dr. Helen Yu.
She's part of a team working on the 29 telescope,
which is used to look at distant stars. Dr. Yu, can you
tell us more about the project?
Kw Sure. ® The Z9 telescope is located in one of the driest
deserts on Earth. We chose that spot so there'd be
very little interference from rain or clouds... so you get
a very clear image.
m And has your team made any interesting
discoveries?
EKw Olt has! Tomorrow I'll be presenting our findings at a
research conference in Sydney. And I can share some
of the highlights with you now.
